solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Wave hard with horse-rider, heading off for sport

indicators.note: with its heading taken off, the word loses its very first letter

blocks.note: a roller is a long heavy sea wave
H is the pencil-grade abbreviation for hard
a jockey rides racehorses

explanation.surface: Someone waves vigorously at a rider, perhaps at a race meeting, before setting off to play a game.
explanation.definitionFit: Roller hockey is a team game played on roller skates, so it is a sport.

clue.text: Elder served up frozen dessert and mostly grim cheese

indicators.note: in a down entry, served up means brought upwards, so the word is read bottom to top
mostly means not quite all, so the word loses its last letter

blocks.note: taken as written
an ice is a frozen dessert
stern means grim and severe

explanation.surface: An older relative is given ice cream along with an unappetising cheese.
explanation.walkthrough: RED LEICESTER is an orange-coloured hard English cheese.
explanation.definitionFit: Red Leicester is a named variety of English cow's-milk cheese.

clue.text: In public, itinerant's lawful

indicators.note: In says the letters sit inside the following words, running across the gap between them

blocks.note: the letters run from the end of the first word into the second

explanation.surface: A traveller's behaviour in public is within the law.
explanation.definitionFit: Licit is a formal synonym meaning permitted by law.

clue.text: Inactive former partner can connect on vacation

indicators.note: on vacation means emptied out, so only the outside letters stay

blocks.note: an ex is a former partner
a tin is a can
first and last letters of the word

explanation.surface: A lazy ex-partner can still get in touch while away on holiday.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vacation' reads like a holiday, but here it means emptying the word of its middle.
explanation.definitionFit: An extinct volcano is permanently inactive, which is the sense used here.

clue.text: Maybe bowler's in this hotel, visiting, with cricket equipment

indicators.note: a visitor is in someone's place, so the letters go inside

blocks.note: H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet
at someone's place means visiting them
a box is the protective guard worn by cricket batsmen

explanation.surface: A cricket bowler stays in a hotel with his kit.
explanation.walkthrough: In the surface the bowler is a cricketer; in the definition it is a hard round hat kept in a hatbox. Here 'visiting' gives AT directly rather than acting as an indicator.
explanation.definitionFit: A hatbox is a case for storing hats, and a bowler is one example of a hat.

clue.text: Dog organisation in Channel Islands

indicators.note: in places the first word inside the abbreviation that follows

blocks.note: ORG is the standard abbreviation for organisation
CI is the abbreviation for the Channel Islands

explanation.surface: A dog charity operates in Jersey and Guernsey.
explanation.walkthrough: The Channel Islands, abbreviated CI, are British islands near France including Jersey and Guernsey.
explanation.definitionFit: The corgi is a small Welsh breed of dog, famously kept by the late Queen.

clue.text: Considering the attraction of English guy in broadcast, on piano

indicators.note: broadcast means scattered widely, so these letters are thrown into a new order

blocks.note: E is the abbreviation for English
taken as written
P is the musical abbreviation for piano, meaning softly

explanation.surface: A broadcaster muses on the appeal of an Englishman appearing on a piano programme.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On' in a down clue puts the following letter underneath, i.e. at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: To eye someone up is to look at them while weighing up how attractive they are.

clue.text: Cocktail, tiny amount, sure to lift Welshwoman

indicators.note: in a down entry, lifting the word turns it to read bottom to top

blocks.note: a whit is the smallest amount, as in not a whit
taken as written
Sian is a common Welsh girl's name

explanation.surface: A small drink is sure to cheer up a woman from Wales.
explanation.definitionFit: A White Russian is a mixed drink of vodka, coffee liqueur and cream.

clue.text: Old coin is article found in tube

indicators.note: found in says one piece sits inside the other

blocks.note: a is the indefinite article
a duct is a tube or channel

explanation.surface: An antique coin turns out to be the object discovered inside a pipe.
explanation.definitionFit: The ducat was a gold or silver coin formerly used across Europe.

clue.text: A shirt unfortunately containing new stain

indicators.note: something gone unfortunately has gone wrong, so the letters are jumbled
containing says the jumbled letters hold another inside them

blocks.note: taken as written
N is the abbreviation for new

explanation.surface: A shirt sadly has a fresh mark on it.
explanation.definitionFit: To tarnish is to stain or dull a surface, also used figuratively of a reputation.

clue.text: Use up each dye, orange firstly

indicators.note: firstly says only the opening letter of the word is wanted

blocks.note: EA is the abbreviation for each
a tint is a dye or colouring
the opening letter

explanation.surface: An instruction to finish off every orange dye.
explanation.definitionFit: To eat into savings or time is to consume part of them, so to use them up.

clue.text: Home acquired metallic bar?

blocks.note: to be in is to be at home
got means obtained

explanation.surface: Someone has bought a house and found a metal bar there.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags that 'metallic bar' could be read as a pub, but it is a cast block of metal.
explanation.definitionFit: An ingot is a block of cast metal, typically oblong, such as a gold bar.

clue.text: Fabric Greek character finally bought in New Zealand

indicators.note: finally says only the closing letter of the word is wanted
in places the selected letter inside the country abbreviation

blocks.note: chi is a letter of the Greek alphabet
NZ is the abbreviation for New Zealand
the closing letter

explanation.surface: A material with a Greek letter on it was eventually purchased in New Zealand.
explanation.definitionFit: Chintz is a printed cotton cloth, usually with a glazed floral pattern.

clue.text: Popular celebrity pinching pound causes anger

indicators.note: pinching means taking hold of, so the word wraps around another

blocks.note: in means fashionable or popular
fame is celebrity
L is the abbreviation for pound (libra)

explanation.surface: A famous star stealing money provokes public fury.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pound' looks like a beating but is the sterling symbol L; 'causes' is a link between wordplay and the verb 'anger'.
explanation.definitionFit: To inflame someone is to provoke them, so it is a verb synonym for to anger.

clue.text: Jack ruined spare gemstone

indicators.note: ruined means wrecked, so the letters fall into a new order

blocks.note: J is jack in a pack of cards
taken as written

explanation.surface: Jack has spoiled a spare precious stone.
explanation.definitionFit: Jasper is an opaque quartz, usually red, cut and polished as a semi-precious stone.

clue.text: Very lengthy mature pine

blocks.note: to age is to mature
to long for something is to pine for it

explanation.surface: An old pine tree that has grown very tall.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pine' looks like a tree but is the verb meaning yearn.
explanation.definitionFit: Agelong describes something lasting for ages, so extremely long in duration.

clue.text: One of five children initially orders all vegan food

indicators.note: initially says only the opening letter of each following word is wanted

blocks.note: a quin is one of quintuplets
opening letters of both words

explanation.surface: One of a set of quintuplets decides what everyone eats, and it is plant-based.
explanation.definitionFit: Quinoa is a grain-like seed eaten as a plant-based staple, so it suits a vegan diet.

clue.text: European capital actress Loren mentioned

indicators.note: mentioned means spoken, so the word is wanted by its sound

blocks.note: Sophia Loren is the Italian film star

explanation.surface: A film star's name comes up in connection with a city in Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: Sofia is the capital city of Bulgaria.

clue.text: Strict religious group remains around Michigan

indicators.note: around says one word wraps the abbreviation that follows

blocks.note: ash is what remains after burning
MI is the postal abbreviation for Michigan

explanation.surface: A puritanical sect's members are still found in a US state.
explanation.definitionFit: The Amish are a traditionalist Christian community known for their plain, strict way of life.

clue.text: Idle American Eileen regularly ignored heartless sharks

indicators.note: regularly ignored means every other letter is dropped, keeping the alternate ones
heartless means the whole middle is removed, leaving only the outside letters

blocks.note: US is short for American
first, third and fifth letters
first and last letters

explanation.surface: A lazy American named Eileen paid no attention to cruel predators.
explanation.definitionFit: Idle in the sense of futile, as in idle threats, means of no use.

clue.text: Cunningly avoid publicity during evening

indicators.note: during places one word within the time span of the other

blocks.note: eve is a poetic word for evening
an ad is publicity

explanation.surface: Someone dodges the press during a night out.
explanation.definitionFit: To evade is to escape or dodge something by cleverness or trickery.

clue.text: Joy, auntie perhaps, runs out

indicators.note: out means removed, so that letter is taken away

blocks.note: an aunt is one example of a family member
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: Delight felt when an aunt rushes outside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Perhaps' marks the aunt as an example of a broader word.
explanation.definitionFit: Elation is a state of great happiness, a synonym of joy.

clue.text: Middle Eastern chap on Love Island

indicators.note: on means placed after, so the word for chap follows the word for Love

blocks.note: O is love, a zero score in tennis
a chap is a man
I is the abbreviation for island

explanation.surface: A man from the Gulf appears on the TV dating show Love Island.
explanation.walkthrough: Love Island is a British reality dating show; the surface hides three pieces in it, with 'on' putting the chap after love.
explanation.definitionFit: Omani means from Oman, a country on the Arabian Peninsula in the Middle East.

clue.text: The banger Len moved somewhere in East London

indicators.note: moved means shifted about, so the letters change places

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Len shifted his old car to a part of London's East End.
explanation.walkthrough: A banger is British slang for a sausage or a battered old car.
explanation.definitionFit: Bethnal Green is a district of the London Borough of Tower Hamlets in the East End.
